name: player_actor_vtable
evidence: Read live from the player actor's +0xe8 while the game was running. Verified statically: .rodata+0xf4 and +0x2bc of this table hold exactly the two function addresses the running game reported.

name: ksys::act::Actor::getMaxLife
evidence: Player actor vtable slot +0xf4. Whole body is `lwz r3,0x1320(r3); blr` - returns *(s32*)(actor+0x1320). Cross-checked three ways: the live actor's vtable slot resolved here, .rodata 0x101e60f0 contains it, and it returns sane values in-game. Returns a CACHE; correct for reading, useless as a write target.

name: ksys::act::Actor::getLife
evidence: Player actor vtable slot +0x2bc. Whole body is `addi r3,r3,0x540; blr` - returns &actor->life. Confirmed at runtime: the running game reported its life pointer at exactly actor+0x540. .rodata 0x101e62b8 contains this address.

name: unnamed_getter_actor_0x544
evidence: Whole body is `lwz r3,0x544(r3); blr` - returns *(s32*)(actor+0x544). Behaviour certain, C++ name not: it is not the vtable slot adjacent to getLife (+0x2c0 is null). Recorded because this is the field an earlier SetMaxLife bug corrupted by writing pLife[1]; it is live actor state, not padding.

name: life
evidence: s32, current life in raw units (4 per heart). From getLife's `addi r3,r3,0x540`, matched by the running game reporting lifePtrOffset=0x540. Genuine storage - writing it works.

name: max_life
evidence: s32, max life in raw units - a CACHE, not storage, and not one that self-heals. From getMaxLife's `lwz r3,0x1320(r3)`; the offset is certain. Writing it does not stick: it reverts and the HUD plays the heart-container-removed (Horned Statue) effect. NOTE an earlier guess that the game refreshes this from the flag every tick is WRONG - setting the flag alone left this stale (flag=24 while this read 20). Use PlayerInfo::setMaxHeartValue, which writes flag and caches together.

name: unknown_actor_0x544
evidence: s32 with a dedicated getter at 0x02d79978. Sits immediately after life (+0x540). Purpose unidentified. Explicitly NOT max life - writing max life here crashes the game.

name: vtable
evidence: Primary actor vtable pointer. Pre-existing module knowledge, re-confirmed live: the value read here resolved to 0x101e5ffc and its slots matched the binary.

name: ksys::gdt::setFlag_MaxHartValue
evidence: Found by following the flag-handle initialiser: FUN_02de6bf4 calls 0x02e2213c (returns the literal "MaxHartValue"), passes it to getS32Handle, and stores the resulting handle to 0x10466ad4. The only other two functions referencing that global are this pair. Body is `setS32(param_1, DAT_10466ad4, param_2)` - value, handle, debug, matching the decompiled `setFlag_MaxHartValue(s32 value, bool debug)`. Signature: void(s32 value, bool debug). Exercised in-game: calling the setter moved the flag from 20 to 24 and the getter read 24 back on a later call. NOTE the write is NOT observable synchronously - re-reading the flag immediately after setting it still returns the old value.

name: ksys::gdt::getFlag_MaxHartValue
evidence: Found by following the flag-handle initialiser: FUN_02de6bf4 calls 0x02e2213c (returns the literal "MaxHartValue"), passes it to getS32Handle, and stores the resulting handle to 0x10466ad4. The only other two functions referencing that global are this pair. Body is `getS32(DAT_10466ad4, param_1)` - handle then debug, matching the decompiled `s32 getFlag_MaxHartValue(bool debug)`. Signature: s32(bool debug). Exercised in-game: calling the setter moved the flag from 20 to 24 and the getter read 24 back on a later call. NOTE the write is NOT observable synchronously - re-reading the flag immediately after setting it still returns the old value.

name: ksys::gdt::setS32
evidence: Generic typed flag setter, reached from setFlag_MaxHartValue. Signature: void(s32 value, FlagHandle handle, bool debug). Argument order matches the decomp.

name: ksys::gdt::getS32
evidence: Generic typed flag getter, reached from getFlag_MaxHartValue. Signature: s32(FlagHandle handle, bool debug).

name: ksys::gdt::Manager::getS32Handle
evidence: Called during flag-handle init as getS32Handle(mgr, name) with a sead string built from the flag-name literal; its return is stored into the per-flag handle global. Matches `mgr->getS32Handle("MaxHartValue")`.

name: gdt_flagname_MaxHartValue
evidence: Whole body returns the string literal "MaxHartValue" (at 0x10202814). One of a run of per-flag name accessors; the next is at 0x02e22148.

name: ksys::gdt::flag_MaxHartValue_handle
evidence: FlagHandle for MaxHartValue, in .data. Written once by the initialiser at 0x02e05564 (`stw r8,0x6ad4(r11)` with r11=0x1046) and read only by the get/set wrappers. Neighbouring handles sit 4 bytes apart (previous is 0x10466ad0).

name: "MaxHartValue"
evidence: GameData flag name for max hearts, in quarter-hearts (4 per heart). Authoritative, save-backed storage for max life; Actor+0x1320 is only a cache of it.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::setMaxHeartValue
evidence: void(PlayerInfo* this, s32 quarter_hearts). Body is exactly the decompiled `{ gdt::setFlag_MaxHartValue(v); mMaxHeartValue = (f32)v; }` - a call to 0x02e1a1f0 followed by a float store to this+0x64 via the standard PPC signed-int-to-double idiom. The only caller of setFlag_MaxHartValue. THIS is the correct entry point for changing max hearts; confirmed working in-game.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::sInstance
evidence: Pointer to the PlayerInfo singleton, in .data. Both callers of setMaxHeartValue load `this` from here and null-check first: 0x02b76718 (`lis r31,0x1046; lwz r31,0x3f38(r31)`) and 0x022a9920 (`lis r29,0x1046; lwzu r3,0x3f38(r29)`). Two independent confirmations.

name: mMaxHeartValue
evidence: f32 cache of the MaxHartValue flag. From the float store at the end of setMaxHeartValue (0x02d4992c). Matches the decomp's PlayerInfo::mMaxHeartValue, also an f32 holding quarter-hearts.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::setStaminaCurrentMax
evidence: void(PlayerInfo* this /*r3*/, f32 value /*f1*/). Sets CURRENT stamina despite the name: writes flag StaminaCurrentMax then stores to this+0x68. PROVEN BY OBSERVATION: sampling this while sprinting in-game gave 3000 -> 1882 -> 3000, i.e. it drains and regenerates. The name says 'current max'; the value is CURRENT stamina. Use for 'set stamina'; for the cap use setStaminaMax (0x02d49dfc).

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::getStaminaCurrentMax
evidence: Returns CURRENT stamina. Whole body is `lfs f1,0x68(r3); blr`. PROVEN BY OBSERVATION: sampling this while sprinting in-game gave 3000 -> 1882 -> 3000, i.e. it drains and regenerates. The name says 'current max'; the value is CURRENT stamina.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::updateStaminaCurrentMaxFromGameData
evidence: Part of the PlayerInfo stamina method block at 0x02d49d70..0x02d49ed4, walked in declaration order and matched against the decomp's actPlayerInfo.h. Calls 0x02e1ac4c with debug=0 and stores the result to this+0x68. The bl target arithmetic (0x02d49de0 + 0xd0e6c) independently confirms 0x02e1ac4c is the GETTER of the pair.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::setStaminaMax
evidence: void(PlayerInfo* this, f32 value). Sets MAX stamina - the cap stamina vessels raise. Writes flag StaminaMax then stores to this+0x6c. Held constant in-game while StaminaCurrentMax moved, which is what distinguishes the two.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::getStaminaMax
evidence: Returns MAX stamina. Whole body is `lfs f1,0x6c(r3); blr`. Constant while current stamina varies.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::updateStaminaMaxFromGameData
evidence: Part of the PlayerInfo stamina method block at 0x02d49d70..0x02d49ed4, walked in declaration order and matched against the decomp's actPlayerInfo.h. Calls 0x02e1ac6c with debug=0 and stores to this+0x6c.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::setMaxStaminaForPlayerActor
evidence: Part of the PlayerInfo stamina method block at 0x02d49d70..0x02d49ed4, walked in declaration order and matched against the decomp's actPlayerInfo.h. Loads mPlayerActor from this+0x30, returns early if null, then `stfs f1,0x1324(actor)`. Safe to call with no actor loaded.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::getMaxStaminaFromPlayerActor
evidence: Part of the PlayerInfo stamina method block at 0x02d49d70..0x02d49ed4, walked in declaration order and matched against the decomp's actPlayerInfo.h. Loads mPlayerActor from this+0x30; returns `lfs f1,0x1324(actor)`, or a 0.0f constant if null.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::recoverStamina
evidence: Calls getMaxStaminaFromPlayerActor then setStaminaCurrentMax - i.e. sets CURRENT stamina to MAX, restoring stamina to full. The exact analogue of recoverLife(). (An earlier note here claimed it 'resyncs the max'; that was wrong, and follows from misreading StaminaCurrentMax as a maximum.)

name: ksys::gdt::setFlag_StaminaCurrentMax
evidence: f32 flags: the value travels in f1, so Ghidra shows get and set wrappers identically. Disambiguated by decompiling the generic they call - 0x02e16988 declares a local float, passes its address as an out-param and returns it (a getter), so the other is the setter. Confirmed by its only caller, PlayerInfo::setStaminaCurrentMax, which calls it and then writes the matching cache. Signature: void(f32 value /*f1*/, bool debug /*r3*/).

name: ksys::gdt::getFlag_StaminaCurrentMax
evidence: f32 flags: the value travels in f1, so Ghidra shows get and set wrappers identically. Disambiguated by decompiling the generic they call - 0x02e16988 declares a local float, passes its address as an out-param and returns it (a getter), so the other is the setter. Calls getF32 with handle 0x10467954. Confirmed as the getter by updateStaminaCurrentMaxFromGameData, which calls it and stores the f1 result.

name: ksys::gdt::setFlag_StaminaMax
evidence: f32 flags: the value travels in f1, so Ghidra shows get and set wrappers identically. Called by PlayerInfo::setStaminaMax immediately before the this+0x6c cache write.

name: ksys::gdt::getFlag_StaminaMax
evidence: f32 flags: the value travels in f1, so Ghidra shows get and set wrappers identically. Disambiguated by decompiling the generic they call - 0x02e16988 declares a local float, passes its address as an out-param and returns it (a getter), so the other is the setter. name: ksys::gdt::getF32
evidence: f32(FlagHandle handle, bool debug). Declares a local float, seeds it with a default, passes its address to the manager accessor and returns it - the shape of the decomp's getF32. Also reveals the gdt::Manager instance pointer at 0x1046d5b0.

name: ksys::gdt::setF32
evidence: void(f32 value /*f1*/, FlagHandle handle, bool debug). Identified by elimination: the other function of the pair reached from the f32 flag wrappers, where 0x02e16988 is provably the getter.

name: ksys::gdt::Manager::getF32Handle
evidence: Called during flag-handle init as getF32Handle(mgr, name) for f32 flags, mirroring getS32Handle (0x02e1e16c) for s32 flags; its result is stored into the per-flag handle global.

name: ksys::gdt::Manager::sInstance

name: ksys::gdt::flag_StaminaCurrentMax_handle
evidence: FlagHandle for StaminaCurrentMax (f32). Written by the initialiser at 0x02e12064; read only by the get/set wrappers at 0x02e1ac4c / 0x02e1ac5c.

name: ksys::gdt::flag_StaminaMax_handle
evidence: FlagHandle for StaminaMax (f32). Read by getFlag_StaminaMax (0x02e1ac6c); sits 4 bytes after the StaminaCurrentMax handle, matching the consecutive-handle layout.

name: "StaminaCurrentMax"
evidence: GameData flag name, f32, wheel units. MISLEADING NAME: this is CURRENT stamina, not a maximum. PROVEN BY OBSERVATION: sampling this while sprinting in-game gave 3000 -> 1882 -> 3000, i.e. it drains and regenerates. The name says 'current max'; the value is CURRENT stamina.

name: "StaminaMax"
evidence: GameData flag name, f32, wheel units. The real maximum - what stamina vessels raise. 1000 = one wheel.

name: mPlayerActor
evidence: PlayerBase* - the player actor. Loaded and null-checked by setMaxStaminaForPlayerActor / getMaxStaminaFromPlayerActor (0x02d49e88 / 0x02d49e9c).

name: mStaminaCurrentMax
evidence: f32 at PlayerInfo+0x68 holding CURRENT stamina in wheel units, cached from flag StaminaCurrentMax. Sits immediately after mMaxHeartValue (+0x64). PROVEN BY OBSERVATION: sampling this while sprinting in-game gave 3000 -> 1882 -> 3000, i.e. it drains and regenerates. The name says 'current max'; the value is CURRENT stamina.

name: mStaminaMax
evidence: f32 at PlayerInfo+0x6c holding MAX stamina in wheel units, cached from flag StaminaMax. 1000 = one wheel, 3000 = the three-wheel cap.

name: max_stamina
evidence: f32 at Actor+0x1324, the player actor's copy of MAX stamina in wheel units, immediately after max_life (+0x1320). From setMaxStaminaForPlayerActor's `stfs f1,0x1324(actor)` and the matching load in getMaxStaminaFromPlayerActor. Held at 3000 in-game while current stamina varied, confirming it is the cap. Unlike max_life this one is written by the game's own setter, so go through that setter.

name: ksys::act::Actor ACTOR_MATRIX
evidence: sead::Matrix34f, row-major 3x4, 48 bytes (0x1f8..0x227). 0x0383b398 copies exactly 12 floats from playerActor+0x1f8 via the matrix-assign helper 0x03c6fe5c, fixing base and size. Game reads gameplay position from the translation column +0x204/+0x214/+0x224 in 0x022b1278, 0x022ae534, 0x025bba8c. OUTPUT ONLY on physics-driven actors - see docs/actor-transforms.md.

name: ksys::act::Actor published transform
evidence: Second Matrix34f. 0x037986e4 writes it from the matrix passed to setMtx, routed through the attach frame at +0x3b8 via 0x034d3d40 when parented. Writing +0x1f8 alone leaves this stale.

name: ksys::act::Actor linear velocity
evidence: Contiguous sead::Vector3f. 0x0383b398 feeds actor+0x25c to 0x03c6fcf0 (= sqrt(v0^2+v1^2+v2^2)) as a speed value, and separately reads +0x25c and +0x264 for sqrt(x^2+z^2) horizontal speed, fixing x/y/z at +0x25c/+0x260/+0x264. NOT a physics input: written to 30.0 it read back for 2 ticks then zeroed.

name: ksys::act::Actor position copy (feet)
evidence: Contiguous Vector3f matching the actor position exactly (dy 0.000). Found by scanning the live actor for its own coordinates. Sibling copies: +0x28c dy +1.500, +0x2bc dy +0.910, +0x2b0 dy ~1.39 (jitters, animated bone). All outputs - reverted within one frame when written.

name: ksys::act::Actor attach frame
evidence: Non-null means the transform is parented (held weapon, worn armour, mounted). setMtx branches on exactly this: 0x037986e4 writes +0x22c directly when null, otherwise routes through 0x034d3d40 against the parent.

name: ksys::act::Actor::setMtx
evidence: setMtx(actor, const Matrix34f*, const Vector3f* velocity). Disassembly: r3 actor, r4 matrix, r5 velocity; copies matrix to actor+0x1f8 via 0x03c6fe5c, calls 0x037986e4, then stores velocity to +0x274/+0x278/+0x27c when non-null. ~30 gameplay call sites. Takes no locks.

name: sead::Matrix34f assign
evidence: Copies 12 floats (src=r3, dst=r4). Argument order is (src, dst).

name: sead::Vector3f length
evidence: sqrt(v[0]^2 + v[1]^2 + v[2]^2) with a Newton refinement step.

name: ksys::act::BaseProcMgr::processJobs
evidence: processJobs(mgr, jobType, prioMask, alsoPending). Source of the whole actor enumeration: mgr+0x64 job-type count, mgr+0x68 bucket array, bucket 0xc0 = 8 slots x 0x18, slot = 2 lists x 0xc {prev,next,count}, node +0x04 next / +0x08 BaseProc* / +0x10 priority. Iterators 0x03791fcc, 0x03791f8c, 0x0379201c, 0x037920d8.

name: ksys::act::BaseProcMgr lock
evidence: sead::CriticalSection guarding the proc lists; its OSMutex is at +0x10. 0x030bb668 is `r3 += 0x10; b OSLockMutex`, 0x030bb69c the unlock. 0x0378a374 locks the same field. Recursive. Without holding it a job-list walk follows freed nodes - counts varied 285/252 across concurrent traversals, stable once locked.

name: ksys::act::BaseProcMgr singleton
evidence: Passed as `this` to 0x0378fc64, 0x0378f210, 0x03790804. Job threads at +0x11c/0x120/0x124.

name: MapPlacement entry array
evidence: sead::SafeArray of 6000 entries, stride 0x124 (spans +0x2d0..+0x6d050). Capacity is the game's own literal: every lookup inlines `if (idx < 6000) base += idx*0x124` - 0x0379e3d4 (5 sites), 0x0379f2a0, 0x0313b84c, 0x0313a878, 0x0313a8e8 (the last as (uint*)base + idx*0x49). No live count exists; the game random-accesses by the u16 at mapObject+0x04, so unused slots hold stale data.

name: physics -> actor transform sync loop
evidence: Spans 0x038079f4..0x038087b8; Ghidra creates no function here. Found via a Cemu write watchpoint on actor+0x2d4. Walks physics entities (stride 0x78), builds each transform, dispatches via 0x03986044 -> (*(*entity+0x74)+0x6c)(entity, matrix, key). THIS is why no actor-side position, velocity or matrix write survives a frame.

name: actor per-frame update (NOT player-specific)
evidence: Previously documented in this module as Player-specific. It is not: logging param_1 showed Weapon_Sword_044 on all 11 presses plus per-frame traces matching several other actors, across multiple job threads. Fires many times per frame for whichever actor is ticking.

name: actor physics/motion object accessor
evidence: No-arg accessor returning the actor's physics object, null for actors without one. 0x0383b398 calls it on the player actor and reads Vector3f at +0xac and +0xc4 of the result; 0x024b0cbc calls it and writes +0x158. Result+0x1f0 is the capsule centre, measured +0.800 above the feet position.
